signal: Zingtree positioned as the first AI Agent Builder for complex support and launched its CX Answers and Actions toolkit

email.body1:
Logan, saw Zingtree leaning hard into the AI Agent Builder positioning with CX Answers and Actions.

A category shift like that usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Zingtree off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Logan, quick follow-up for Zingtree.

When the product story sharpens, pipeline targets usually climb faster than you can add reps. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zingtree needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Logan, last bit of proof for Zingtree.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zingtree's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Logan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and a product repositioning is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Zingtree either way.
